data.name: faq_es_una_suite_de_analitica_conductual
data.value: It is a behavioral analytics suite based on eye tracking. A Tobii device records where your user looks while using your digital product, and the platform turns that data into heat maps, areas of interest, gaze paths and attention metrics ready to interpret.

data.name: faq_escribenos_desde_la_pantalla_de_planes
data.value: Write to us from the plans screen and we'll answer shortly.

data.name: faq_espanol_ingles_y_portugues_cada_usuario

data.name: faq_falke_usa_hardware_de_infrarrojo_dedicad
data.value: Falke uses dedicated infrared hardware, not the computer's webcam. This gives higher accuracy and is not affected by the participant's posture or lighting. We also impose no limit on duration or asset type: you can analyze a video game or a complete software flow.

data.name: faq_hay_limite_de_duracion_en_las
data.value: Is there a limit on session duration?

data.name: faq_los_datos_de_seguimiento_ocular_se
data.value: Eye tracking data is dissociated from the tester's identity at the moment it is saved: what remains stored does not allow the person to be identified. It is a requirement of Law No. 25,326 on Personal Data Protection and is considered from the design of the system.

data.name: faq_no_el_modelo_de_falke_esta
data.value: No. Falke's model is designed so that you work with your own users, in your own environment. This gives much more fidelity than an external panel, especially for products with specific audiences. We also don't do design consulting: we deliver the evidence, the decision is up to your team.

data.name: faq_si_cada_analisis_se_exporta_a
data.value: Yes. Each analysis is exported to PDF by choosing with checkboxes which visualizations and metrics to include. That report can be shared with anyone, without them needing to enter the platform.

data.name: faq_si_con_el_analisis_multiple_planes
data.value: Yes, with multiple analysis (Hunter and Apex plans). The data of several sessions is averaged to see common patterns across different testers. The platform validates that all sessions are of the same asset type, because otherwise the average would not be valid.

data.value: If the failure is not attributable to use, repair or replacement is at Pattern Blue's expense, at no additional cost. Damage from impacts, liquids, unauthorized modifications or loss is excluded.
